findings.summary: Month group headers count the whole filtered month, so page 2 shows 'September 2026 · 5 emails' above 2 rows. Deliberate and documented; confirm with the user or switch to page-local counts.
Between 700 and 800px the fixed 220px sender column squeezes subjects to about 124px (about 20 characters). Cosmetic; consider minmax(140px,220px) or a narrower sender column at mid widths.

#count has aria-live=polite and search re-renders on every input event, so each keystroke that changes the total queues a screen-reader announcement. Consider debouncing or announcing only on page changes.
